question: A and B can do a certain work in 221 over 2 days and 30 days, respectively. They started the work together but after 6 days, B had to leave. Then, A working with C and completed the remaining work in 3 days. C alone can complete the original work in :
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

A + B's 6-day work = (30 + 22.5) × 6 = 315

Remaining work = 675 - 315 = 360

∴ A + C's 3-day work = 360

So, (A + C) × 3 = 360

⇒ 30 + C = 360/3 = 120

⇒ C = 90

Time taken by C to complete the work alone

⇒ T꜀ = 675/90 = 7.5 = 7(1)/(2)

∴ C alone can complete the work in 71over2 days.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A complete a work in 221 over 2 days

B complete a work in 30 days

They worked together but after 6 days B had to leave

**Calculation:**

1-day work of A = 2/45, and 1-day work of B = 1/30

A + B's 1-day work = 2/45 + 1/30 = 7/90

A + B's 6-day work = 7over90 × 6 = 7/15

Remaining work when B left = 1 - 7/15 = 8/15

Let C complete the work in x days

∴ C's 1-day work = 1/x

A + C's 1-day work = 2/45 + 1/x 

Remaining work done by A and C in 3 days = (2/45 + 1/x)3 = 8/15

⇒ 2/45 + 1/x = 8/45

⇒ 1/x = 8/45 - 2/45

⇒ 1/x = 6/45

⇒ x = 15/2 = 71over2

**∴ C alone can complete the work in 71over2 days.**
